anatomy.reason: Both views show two thin tentacles with basal eyes, but the shell reads as roughly three whorls rather than four and lacks a clearly sunken coil centre.

style.reason: Dark ink outlines are confident, but dense mottling and extensive tonal shading exceed the requested flat two-to-three-tone colour and light marker texture.

no_slop.reason: There are no cute facial features, decorative effects, text, extra tentacles or obvious rendering artefacts.

layout.reason: A side view on the left and three-quarter view on the right depict a consistent individual at comparable scale against a plain light background.

fix: Draw approximately four steadily expanding whorls with visibly recessed centres, preserve the narrow disc profile, and simplify the colouring to three flat tones with sparse marker texture.
overall: Recognisable ramshorn snail, but the shell structure and overly worked colouring need revision.
